failed_jobs.name: Tests / Package tests - macOS (class, Aspire.Templates.Tests, Templates-NUnit_NewUpAndBuildSupportProjectTemplatesTests... / Templates-NUnit_NewUpAndBuildSupportProjectTemplatesTests (macos-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: CanNewAndBuild(aspire-nunit, Net9) failed because the Roslyn compiler process itself threw 'Method not found: HashAlgorithmToPal' while opening a generated AssemblyInfo.cs file, indicating a corrupted/mismatched macOS Roslyn/SDK toolset rather than a defect in PR-generated template code. This matches a previously observed pattern of similar Roslyn 'Method not found' failures on macos-latest in the same test flow.
